reasons.action: The only supplied reference is an audio track carrying voice timbre and a spoken line; it supplies no observed motion or pose. The requested re-delivery of the line is therefore governed by the request, which has no competing visual source to defer to.
reasons.medium: No visual reference is attached and the medium owner is already pinned by the accepted no_reference decision; rendering medium is therefore settled by request rather than by any observed reference appearance.
reasons.wardrobe: The audio reference offers no clothing observation, and the brief names no garments. With no observed wardrobe to retain, wardrobe remains request-governed.
reasons.lighting: Nothing in the supplied audio reference describes illumination, and the intent says nothing about light sources, direction or quality. Lighting is thus unresolved by any reference and falls to the request.
reasons.framing: The audio reference carries no camera composition, shot scale or viewpoint, and the stated 16:9 canvas and 8-second duration are not framing instructions. Framing stays request-governed.
reasons.palette: The audio reference supplies no color information, and the brief requests no scene palette. Palette is therefore governed by the request alone.
